title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Value City Arena, Columbus | 1999
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Value City Arena in the Schottenstein Center in Columbus, Ohio, USA, on 22 February 1999.

It was the ninth show by the fifth All-Starr Band. Their US tour lasted for 30 dates in February and March 1999.

Paul McCartney performed at the Value City Arena on 10 October 2002 and 22 October 2005.

The fifth All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Todd Rundgren: vocals, guitar, percussion
  • Gary Brooker: vocals, keyboards, organ
  • Jack Bruce: vocals, bass guitar, keyboards
  • Timmy Cappello: vocals, saxophone, keyboards, harmonica, guitar
  • Simon Kirke: vocals, drums

Concert setlist

  • It Don’t Come Easy
  • ‘Act Naturally’
  • ‘Whisky Train’ (Gary Brooker)
  • ‘I Saw The Light’ (Todd Rundgren)
  • ‘Sunshine Of Your Love’ (Jack Bruce)
  • ‘Shooting Star’ (Simon Kirke)
  • ‘Boys’
  • ‘Love Me Do’
  • ‘Yellow Submarine’

  • ‘All Right Now’ (Simon Kirke)
  • ‘I Wanna Be Your Man’

  • ‘White Room’ (Jack Bruce)
  • ‘A Whiter Shade Of Pale’ (Gary Brooker)
  • ‘Photograph’
  • ‘You’re Sixteen’
  • ‘With A Little Help From My Friends’
